name: Jason Palter
text: Ori was fantastic to deal with, and was kind enough to recommend a great deal from Costco for me to purchase my garage door opener. He and Idad arrived on time, did great work on the installation of the opener, and even showed me how to set up the software on my phone. I'm very pleased with York Garage Pros, and would highly recommend them!

name: Anita Veldhuizen
text: Ori and his partner spent considerable time to figure out what the issue was, and took the time to show me exactly what needed to be done. Even on a terribly snowy day, they made the effort to help.

name: George
text: York Garage Pros are a wonderful company to do business with. I called them when our garage door would not open or close. The first thing they asked was, 'is it an emergency' I said it wasn't, but a technician came within 2 hours. So kind and professional, they had everything repaired and working the same day. They left my garage very clean.
